paragraphs.text: Sandruu was an Anaba minotaur and planeswalker from Ulgrotha , and a good friend of Feroz , who helped him ascend .

When out exploring the multiverse , Sandruu fell in love with Kristina of the Woods . This enraged Taysir , her former lover, who hunted Sandruu down and banished him to a plane from which it would take a millennium to return. However, seven decades later, Sandruu was called to Dominaria by Ravidel 's Mox Beacon to fight in the Planeswalkers' War . Ravidel recruited Sandruu to his cause by showing him out-of-context images of Kristina in bed with Jared Carthalion .

As an Anaba minotaur , Sandruu may have access to red mana. However, in his appearance in Magic: The Gathering - BattleMage , Sandruu's default campaign deck includes primarily white cards alongside a small number of blue cards.
Since the comic depicting the war was never made, what happened to Sandruu is unknown.
